For each class and IoU threshold, sort detections by confidence, match predictions to eligible ground-truth objects within the same image using COCO's rules, and count unmatched/duplicate detections as false positives. Accumulate precision and recall in score order. Form the nonincreasing precision envelope and average interpolated precision over 101 recall points from 0 to 1. [1](https://cocodataset.org/#detection-eval)

AP50 averages this AP across evaluated classes at IoU 0.50. COCO AP averages over classes and ten thresholds 0.50, 0.55, ..., 0.95, with its standard area and maximum-detection settings. Ignore/crowd rules and classes with no eligible ground truth require the official evaluator; simplistic matching can disagree. Report small/medium/large-object and recall metrics too. Classification confidence alone cannot compensate for a box that misses the required overlap threshold.
